messages.subject: S4 fix round done
messages.body: Fixed F1 on fleet/build-s4 (head 4aa7755): autolinks (URL, other schemes, email) now convert to their inner text before HTML tag stripping, so '## <http://example.com>' yields label http://example.com and slug httpexamplecom; real tags still strip and code spans stay literal. Added red-first tests for F1 plus the F2 precomposed-accent guard and F3 depth-filtered duplicate suffix guard (a, a-2); full suite passes via python3 -m unittest discover (95 tests OK). Nothing left; not pushed, SPEC.md untouched, no commit trailers per CLAUDE.md.
